sources.guides: Our own advice, written from the official descriptions alone. GTA 6 released 2026-11-19 and the guides have not been checked in the game; any step or location not pinned down by the official description is marked as unverified in the guide itself.
sources.names_descriptions_grades: Exophase official PS5 trophy list (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/), frozen 2026-11-18; grades cross-checked against PSNProfiles (https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi).
sources.psn_counts: No PSN rarity counts are shown: none had been verified at the time of writing, and no numbers are invented here.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: work the roadmap in order, clear the missable story trophies while their windows are open, and leave the 100% completion trophy for last. If you are following this guide from the start, the platinum is simply the sum of everything below.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it. It doubles as the game's tutorial, so it teaches the basics as you go and the trophy pops at the end of the mission. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its story missions in order. Story trophies like this one come from progress alone, so just keep playing the main missions and it will unlock at the chapter's end. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its story missions in order. Like the other chapter trophies, it is awarded for story progress and nothing else. If you are playing the story straight through, it arrives on its own.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its story missions in order. This is the halfway point of the story's chapter trophies, so by now the pattern is clear: main missions only, no detours required. Keep the story moving and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its story missions in order. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so once it pops you are on the home stretch of the story. Before the final mission, check the missables page: anything tied to a story window should be done first.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It is the gold story trophy, so expect a longer, harder mission than the chapter ones. Before you start it, clear every other story-window trophy on the missables page: the official description does not say what remains open afterwards, and whether free roam continues after the finale has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: The final mission itself. Before starting it, clear every other story-window trophy: the official description does not say what remains open afterwards, and whether free roam continues after the finale has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears. The trophy is for finishing the mission, so there is no special objective to chase inside it. Play it safe and finish it in one go: whether missions can be replayed has not been verified in the game yet, so do not count on a second chance.
trophies.miss_window: During the mission Breakfast Run. Finish the mission cleanly the first time rather than relying on a replay.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually come with setup steps first, so follow the story prompts until the heist itself starts; the trophy is for finishing the heist, not the setup. As with the other named missions, finish it cleanly the first time rather than relying on a replay, which has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: During the mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist; do not rely on a replay.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears. The trophy is for finishing the mission, so play it through to its end. Finish it in one go rather than relying on a replay, which has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: During the mission Child's Play. Finish the mission; do not rely on a replay.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners when it appears. The trophy is for finishing the mission, so there is no hidden objective to hunt for inside it. Finish it cleanly the first time rather than relying on a replay, which has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: During the mission Headliners. Finish the mission; do not rely on a replay.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears. The name points at the airport, VCIA, so expect the action to centre on it, but the trophy itself is simply for finishing the mission. Finish it in one go rather than relying on a replay, which has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: During the mission VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission; do not rely on a replay.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears. The trophy is for finishing the mission, so play it through to the end. Finish it cleanly the first time rather than relying on a replay, which has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: During the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission; do not rely on a replay.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: story, side missions, activities, collectibles, all of it. This is the last trophy for most players, and the in-game stats page tracks what is still missing, so check it before chasing the final few percent. Do not grind for it until the other 53 trophies are done; by then only a short cleanup list should remain.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total: jumps, airtime, near misses and the like, counted cumulatively across the whole game. Drive fast, use ramps and jumps in free roam, and the count climbs on its own while you play. It is a grind rather than a skill test, so do not farm it early; let it build up and finish the remainder in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. One session of each is enough, so work through the in-game activities menu and tick them off one by one. This is an easy early trophy: it only asks you to sample everything, not to master any of it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold threshold, so learn one weapon and scoring pattern at a time rather than rushing through all 42. This is the hardest skill trophy on the list, so save it for a focused session and expect to repeat the tougher challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Winning once per location is enough, so learn each course's line and move on; there is no need to repeat a course you have already won. The race menu tracks which locations you have won at, so check it before travelling to the next one.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each win has to be a race you have not won before, so vary the events instead of repeating your favourite. The race menu shows which you have already won; work through the un-won ones until the count hits 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges run through the fishing activity, so keep fishing until Cal's challenge is offered, then accept it and out-fish him. Exactly how the challenge is triggered has not been verified in the game yet, so if it does not appear, keep working through the fishing activity and check back.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game: finish a full game at an arcade machine, not just start one. Pick the shortest game on the machine you find first and play it to its end. It is a quick trophy once you are standing at a machine.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a chain of side missions, so keep accepting his missions whenever they appear until the finale unlocks. Finish the finale when it does: like the story missions, whether side missions can be replayed has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: Andy's last mission. Keep taking Andy's missions when they appear until the finale unlocks, and finish it when it does.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a chain of side missions, so keep accepting his missions whenever they appear until the finale unlocks. Finish the finale when it does: like the story missions, whether side missions can be replayed has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: Kenton's last mission. Keep taking Kenton's missions when they appear until the finale unlocks, and finish it when it does.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a chain of side missions, so keep accepting his missions whenever they appear until the finale unlocks. Finish the finale when it does: like the story missions, whether side missions can be replayed has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: Billy's last mission. Keep taking Billy's missions when they appear until the finale unlocks, and finish it when it does.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as markers in free roam; take their missions and follow each chain to its end. It is 8 full strands, not 8 single missions, so a strand only counts once its finale is done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a chain of side missions, so keep accepting his missions whenever they appear until the finale unlocks. Finish the finale when it does: like the story missions, whether side missions can be replayed has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: Randy's last mission. Keep taking Randy's missions when they appear until the finale unlocks, and finish it when it does.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a chain of side missions, so keep accepting his missions whenever they appear until the finale unlocks. Finish the finale when it does: like the story missions, whether side missions can be replayed has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: Tyrone's last mission. Keep taking Tyrone's missions when they appear until the finale unlocks, and finish it when it does.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are found in the world, so work through them region by region rather than criss-crossing the map. Whether the spots are marked on the map before you find them has not been verified in the game yet, so explore scenic and quiet places if a spot is not showing up.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at the animal, so follow his lead rather than hunting at random. The exact animal and its location are not pinned down by the official description and have not been verified in the game yet, so take the strand's in-game directions as they come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set only counts when it is full, so any 3 complete sets will do. Check the collectibles menu to see which sets are nearly done and hunt those cards first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations, counted cumulatively. The practical approach is to use it whenever you arrive somewhere new, so the count grows alongside exploration instead of becoming a separate grind. What WAiNK It is in the game has not been verified from the official description alone, so follow the in-game prompt for it when it appears.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's checklist of feats, and the in-game challenges menu shows your progress, so open it and pick off the easy ones first. Many complete naturally while you hunt the other trophies, so check the menu late in the game and mop up the remainder deliberately.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you in free roam, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is breaking line of sight and staying hidden until the stars clear, so head for alleys, tunnels or water rather than outrunning cars in the open. Do it while your partner is available: whether they stay available after the story ends has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: While your partner is available in free roam. Do it before the story ends: whether your partner stays available afterwards has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. This is the opposite of running from the cops: the heat has to stay on between robberies, so plan a route of three shops close together and move fast from one to the next. If the wanted level drops to zero between shops, the chain breaks and you start again.
trophies.miss_window: While your partner is available in free roam. Do it before the story ends: whether your partner stays available afterwards has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: get in or drive 100 different vehicles, counted cumulatively. Variety is what counts, so try everything you see rather than sticking to one car. It builds up fast if you make a habit of swapping vehicles whenever a new one appears.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a fight with five or more enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop them before it ends. A crowded shootout is the place to try it; if you fall short, set it up again and retry until all five fall inside one use.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport: leave without a ticket, in the plainest reading by taking a plane yourself. The exact trigger has not been verified in the game yet, so the honest advice is to try the obvious route first: get to a plane on the tarmac and take off. If that does not pop it, try other ways of leaving the airport by air.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The official description is cryptic: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Rhinos are tanks, so the trophy involves a Rhino tank somehow, most plausibly stealing one, driving one, or surviving one. No specific step has been verified in the game yet, so try commandeering a Rhino in free roam first and see what the game asks of you; do not trust any walkthrough that states a precise trigger without a source.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no one raising the alarm, no cameras catching you. Plan the entry, take the goods, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, leave and retry rather than fighting through it, since detection is what fails the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, counted cumulatively. Vault robberies are bigger jobs than a shop hold-up, and each one only counts if you get away clean afterwards, so plan the escape route before the grab. Five total across the whole game, so work through them one at a time between other trophies.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes in free roam, so intercept one, crack it open, and get away clean. One truck is enough, and the escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop fighting the wanted level until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so drive through every region until the counter hits 52. Combine it with the WAiNK and meditation runs: visiting new ground for those trophies fills this one in at the same time.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's operations have to be found first, so work through all nine gangs one by one. How operations are revealed in the game has not been verified from the official description alone, so follow the in-game leads for each gang as they appear.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; the trophy is for the moment, not a challenge. It is a deliberately slow one, so do it between jobs when you are passing the beach anyway.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass. Pick a showroom, get a car moving inside it or ram one through the front, and exit through the glass. The 'classic style' in the description points at the old-school smash-and-grab exit, so a clean drive through the window is the move.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. 'Follow-through' reads as finishing what you start, so play a full game rather than a single frame to be safe. The alley is named in the description, so head straight there once you can reach it in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description is vague: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' It reads as a notable moment with your partner, but no specific step is pinned down by the description and none has been verified in the game yet. Treat it as a watch item during partner activities and check the trophy menu for a progress target; do not trust a walkthrough that states a precise trigger without a source.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The official description is just 'Choices made (for better or worse).' It most plausibly counts the story choices you make along the way, so make decisions when the game offers them instead of avoiding them. Its exact trigger has not been verified in the game yet, so treat it as a watch item through the story: if a choice is one-time-only, it cannot be taken later, which is why it is flagged here.
trophies.miss_window: Story choices, as they are offered. Make decisions when the game offers them instead of avoiding them; if a choice is one-time-only, it cannot be taken later.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail something, then succeed on the immediate retry. If a mission or challenge goes wrong, retry it right away rather than reloading an old save. The retry itself is the trigger, so a failed attempt followed at once by a success is what you are aiming for.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in the world: a one-off event, by the sound of the description. These events are rare and easy to walk past, so explore odd corners of Leonida and pay attention when something unusual happens. It may trigger only once, so do not skip a strange scene when you find one; what exactly it is has not been verified in the game yet.
trophies.miss_window: A one-off world event, whenever it appears. It may trigger only once, so do not skip a strange scene when you find one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a target and swing as you pass; the trophy pops on the knockdown. It is a quick one once you have a melee weapon and a slow car.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, and your contacts clean them for a cut, so keep laundering after every big job and the total adds up. It is cumulative across the whole game, so it finishes on its own if you rob steadily and launder every time.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops: clothes, weapons, food, anything counts, and the total is cumulative. Normal spending across the game gets you most of the way there, so do not force it early. Late in the game, top it up with one big purchase if you are still short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property market, so save up and buy them as they become available. They also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you discover, so they pair naturally with the vehicle trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app, register it, and repeat until 10 different vehicles are on the list. Any vehicles count, so register the ones you are already driving and the total climbs fast.
trophies.name: On the Spot
